notes.title: Patch Notes 05
notes.content:
[list]
[*] Rework on the AI reinforcement ship type selection mechanism for Skirmish maps.
[*] Some other minor graphic fix
[/list]

notes.title: Patch Notes 04
notes.content:
[list]
[*] Camera now focus back to friendly ships after enemy's turn
[*] Fix some attack symbol not displaying issues
[*] Lower the difficulty of tutorial levels
[/list]

notes.title: Patch Notes 03
notes.content:
[list]
[*] Fix highlight position of some structures in the tutorial of Battle of Mars 2
[*] Enhance the highlight of task icon and terrain icon in tutorials
[*] Fix the game lock problem when back from pause menu
[*] Fix a occasionaly crash after exit from level
[/list]

notes.title: Patch Notes 02
notes.content:
[list]
[*] Fix a bug that may prevent player to continue in the First Day level, when player hold left mouse button on enemy ship to show enemy attack area
[*] Improve the click detection mechanism, fighter on passable terrain is easier to be selected now
[*] Increase the dialog text showup speed
[*] Add highlight on structures that need to be occupied in tutorials to further guide players throught the tutorial
[/list]

notes.title: Patch Notes 01
notes.content:
Bug Fix
[list]
[*] fix a bug that AI could be used to attack and destroy near by AI ships
[*] fix the weapon model doesn't cleared issue in Custom Mode
[*] fix some typo in Tutorials and some typo in weapon description
[*] remove some wrong equip on Alpha ships in levels
[*] fix AI move range mark could be seen after save/load
[/list]
